exposure: International Obesity Task Force (IOTF) cut-off points
outcome: Prevalence of overweight or obesity (ow/ob) in 2-6 year old children
cohort: 7664 children 2 to 6 years of age in Hunan, China
finding: The prevalence of overweight/obesity in preschool children in Hunan Province is high, particularly when using Chinese BMI criteria, and is associated with residing in urban areas, older age, male sex, frequent snacking, macrosomia delivery, caesarean birth, and higher maternal prepregnancy and pre-delivery weight.
mod_finding: Caesarean birth was associated with a higher prevalence of overweight/obesity in the children.
